statements:
CREATE TABLE studio_entities (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	current_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (kind IN ('character','scene','prop')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_studio_entities_owner_id ON studio_entities (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_studio_entities_project_id ON studio_entities (project_id)

CREATE TABLE studio_asset_families (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	current_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_studio_asset_families_owner_id ON studio_asset_families (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_studio_asset_families_project_id ON studio_asset_families (project_id)

CREATE TABLE studio_scripts (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_text VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	adaptation_mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id), 
	CHECK (adaptation_mode IN ('original','adapt')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_story_scenes (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	synopsis VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_commands (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	operation_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	command_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_id, project_id, operation_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_project_snapshots (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	manifest JSONB NOT NULL, 
	manifest_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, project_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_timelines (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ticks_per_second BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	fps_num INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fps_den INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	audio_sample_rate INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	music_gain DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT '0.25' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id), 
	CHECK (ticks_per_second > 0 AND fps_num > 0 AND fps_den > 0 AND audio_sample_rate > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_entity_versions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	origin_version_id VARCHAR, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	voice_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	voice_configuration_id VARCHAR(100), 
	voice_configuration_revision INTEGER, 
	voice_parameters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (entity_id, version_no), 
	UNIQUE (entity_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(voice_configuration_id, voice_configuration_revision) REFERENCES model_configuration_versions (configuration_id, revision), 
	CHECK (version_no > 0), 
	CHECK (num_nonnulls(voice_configuration_id, voice_configuration_revision) IN (0,2)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_id) REFERENCES studio_entities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(origin_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_studio_entity_versions_entity_id ON studio_entity_versions (entity_id)

CREATE TABLE studio_asset_versions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parent_version_id VARCHAR, 
	file_id VARCHAR(100), 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_job_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (family_id, version_no), 
	UNIQUE (family_id, id), 
	CHECK (version_no > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_families (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES web_file_entries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_job_id) REFERENCES studio_media_jobs (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_studio_asset_versions_family_id ON studio_asset_versions (family_id)

CREATE TABLE studio_shots (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	story_scene_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scene VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	camera VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	framing VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	movement VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	planned_duration_ms BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, story_scene_id) REFERENCES studio_story_scenes (project_id, id), 
	CHECK (planned_duration_ms > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_tracks (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, position) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_timelines (project_id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_entity_version_assets (
	entity_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	asset_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (entity_version_id, asset_version_id, purpose), 
	UNIQUE (entity_version_id, purpose, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_lines (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	shot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	speaker_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	text VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	voice VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, shot_id) REFERENCES studio_shots (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(speaker_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_project_assets (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	asset_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, asset_version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_project_entity_versions (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_version_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, entity_version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES studio_projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_shot_references (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	shot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entity_version_id VARCHAR, 
	asset_version_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, shot_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, shot_id) REFERENCES studio_shots (project_id, id), 
	CHECK (num_nonnulls(entity_version_id, asset_version_id) = 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(entity_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE studio_clips (
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	track_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	shot_id VARCHAR, 
	line_id VARCHAR, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR, 
	asset_version_id VARCHAR, 
	start_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	duration_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_start_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_duration_ticks BIGINT, 
	subtitle_text VARCHAR, 
	gain DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	timing_mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	anchor_offset_ticks BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	subtitle_follow_voice BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, track_id) REFERENCES studio_tracks (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, shot_id) REFERENCES studio_shots (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, line_id) REFERENCES studio_lines (project_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id, job_id) REFERENCES studio_media_jobs (project, id), 
	CHECK (start_ticks >= 0 AND duration_ticks >= 0 AND source_start_ticks >= 0), 
	CHECK (num_nonnulls(job_id, asset_version_id) <= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES studio_media_jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (id)
)

ALTER TABLE studio_asset_families ADD CONSTRAINT fk_studio_asset_current FOREIGN KEY(id, current_version_id) REFERENCES studio_asset_versions (family_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
ALTER TABLE studio_entities ADD CONSTRAINT fk_studio_entity_current FOREIGN KEY(id, current_version_id) REFERENCES studio_entity_versions (entity_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
